mapper.select:
select o.family_id, o.meal_slot_id, o.id as order_id, oi.dish_id, o.service_date, o.status as order_status, di.ingredient_name, di.quantity, di.unit, di.calc_type, oi.quantity as dish_quantity from orders o join order_items oi on oi.order_id = o.id join dish_ingredients di on di.dish_id = oi.dish_id where o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and o.service_date = #{date} and o.status not in ('CANCELLED', 'REJECTED')
and o.status != 'PENDING'
order by o.family_id asc, o.meal_slot_id asc, o.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into temp_purchase_items (merchant_id, service_date, meal_slot_id, family_id, ingredient_name, quantity, unit, remark, checked) values (#{merchantId}, #{serviceDate}, #{mealSlotId}, #{familyId}, #{ingredientName}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{remark}, #{checked})
mapper.delete: delete from temp_purchase_items where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and id = #{itemId}
